slots.name: title
slots.about: the app's name, the screen title

slots.name: ask
slots.about: the question in the soft card on top: how is it right now

slots.name: steps
slots.about: the points on the scale, low to high: id (1 up), name; 2 or more, or the empty note shows; the first, middle and last names are the anchors

slots.name: value_line
slots.about: the large line over the slider; may read touched (a point is set) and pos_name (its name)

slots.name: last_line
slots.about: the line under the anchors; may read has_last (an earlier day was kept), last_name and last_ago (days since)

slots.name: empty_text
slots.about: shown in place of the scale when steps has fewer than 2 points

slots.name: done_line
slots.about: the footer line once today is kept and not moved since; may read saved_name and day_count (days kept)

slots.name: slide
slots.about: {event}: the host sends the slider's position from 0 to 1 while dragging; it snaps to the nearest point

slots.name: pick
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: tap one point under the slider (value: the point's place from 0), the same snap without a drag

slots.name: save
slots.about: {event, value expression, label}: keeps today's point, or replaces today's when moved; the label may read checked_in

empty.shows: empty_note only; no scale and no save

fallback.shows: the knob rests in the middle at half strength, the value line asks for a touch, save is dimmed and does nothing; a point set on an earlier day reads as not set

attention.shows: done_row in place of save_btn; moving the point brings save back to replace today

accessibility.reduce_motion: the phone drops swap, snappy, shrink and rise
accessibility.not_colour_alone: the picked point is a larger dot, the value line names it, and every point is a tap target as well as a place on the drag
